# Task Panel — "Tasks Window" expansion plan

Turn the right-edge `<TaskPanel>` from a static cross-file list into a configurable workspace — full-screen mode, resizable, scope toggle, quick-filter chips, view tabs, click-to-open. Phase 4 shipped the foundation; this plan layers power-user features on top.

- **Date opened:** 2026-04-24
- **Owner:** aman
- **Status:** ideation — Tier 1 ready to build, Tier 2/3 backlog
- **Source component:** `apps/chrome-ext/src/app/shell/TaskPanel.tsx`
- **Related store:** `apps/chrome-ext/src/app/taskIndex.ts`
- **Feeds into:** `TASKS.md` (copy Tier 1 work items into a new milestone when picked)

---

## Pitch — why expand the panel

Today's `TaskPanel` is a **read-only cross-file list**. It aggregates every task across every opened doc and lets the user filter by smart tab + search + group-by. That's enough to *see* tasks. It's not enough to *work* with them.

Power users want a **command center** — Linear / Things / Notion-database energy — that lives inside the docs they already write. Same one-grep-answers-everything story as the rest of filemark. Reader-first stays — markdown is still the source of truth — but the reader gets a workspace, not just a viewer.

**Three jobs the new panel does:**

1. **Triage** — see what needs attention right now (today, overdue, blocked, untriaged).
2. **Slice** — answer "what does Alice owe me at p0?" or "what's open in `(launch)`?" in two clicks.
3. **Navigate** — jump to the source line in any file in one click; never lose context.

---

What's already wired in `TaskPanel.tsx`:

## Tier 1 — first slice (≤ 1 week)

Five features that flip the panel from "list" to "workspace." Each is ≤ 1 day.

<TaskList title="Tier 1 — workspace foundation" filter="(M-tasks-window-1)" sort="priority:asc"></TaskList>

**Definition of done for Tier 1:** Panel can be expanded to full-screen, resized, scoped to current file/folder/library, filtered with one click via chips, and viewed as list/board/timeline/stats. All persisted across sessions.

Once Tier 1 lands, these turn the panel from "workspace" into "the thing you live in."

<TaskList title="Tier 3 — backlog" filter="(M-tasks-window-3)" sort="priority:asc"></TaskList>

## Open questions before picking Tier 1

1. **Full-screen vs popout** — should Tier 1 ship "fills the viewport" only, or also OS popout window? Popout is more useful on second-monitor setups but adds chrome-extension API surface (`chrome.windows`). Lean toward viewport-fill for v1; popout slips to Tier 3.
2. **Chip-vs-DSL precedence** — when both chips and the DSL textbox are active, who wins? Two options: (a) DSL replaces chip state when typed (chips visually grey out); (b) chips and DSL AND together. Lean (a) — simpler mental model, easier to reset.
3. **Scope persistence** — should "This file / Folder / Library" be per-file (so `notes.md` always opens with `This file`), per-session (last scope sticks), or always default to Library? Lean per-session — least surprising.
4. **Inline edit safety** — writing back to the markdown file means edits race with whatever the user is doing in their editor of choice (VS Code, Obsidian, etc.). Should inline edit be opt-in (preference flag), or always-on with a "saved 2s ago" indicator? Lean opt-in for v1 — filemark's pitch is reader-first.
5. **Saved views storage** — UIPrefs (per-browser) or filesystem (a `.filemark/views.json` per project root)? UIPrefs is faster to ship; filesystem makes views shareable via git. Lean UIPrefs for v1, revisit when teams ask.

---

## Design notes

### Resize handle implementation

<Callout type="info">
  Mouse-down on a 4px-wide left-edge div → start drag → mousemove updates `tasksPanelWidth` in store (debounced) → mouseup → persist to UIPrefs. Keep the handle inside the panel, not floating in the viewer area, so clicks on viewer content don't trigger resize accidentally.
</Callout>

### Full-screen toggle

When `tasksFullscreen=true`, render `<TaskPanel>` as `position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:50` in the shell layout. Hide TopBar + Viewer + Sidebar via conditional class. Esc key handler (added at shell level, not panel) toggles back.

### Scope filter — predicate composition

`useTaskIndex` already has `allTasks()` and `tasksFor(fileId)`. Add `tasksUnderPath(prefix: string)` that walks the index and returns tasks whose `filePath` starts with `prefix`. The scope selector picks the source array; the filter pipeline (chips + DSL + search) runs on top of whichever array.

### Quick-filter chips — auto-deriving values

Render only chips for facets that exist in the **current scope's task set**. e.g. if no task in the current file has `@bob`, no `@bob` chip appears. Use `useMemo(() => indexFacets(scopedTasks), [scopedTasks])` — returns `{statuses, owners, priorities, projects, tags, areas}`.

### View tabs — re-use shipped components

| Tab | Component | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| List | existing TaskPanel rows | with chip-edit additions |
| Board | `<Kanban md group-by="status">` from `@filemark/mdx` | needs prop to accept `Task[]` directly, not just `md` flag |
| Timeline | `<TaskTimeline md>` | same — accept `Task[]` |
| Stats | `<TaskStats md>` | same |

This may require lifting `<Kanban>` / `<TaskTimeline>` / `<TaskStats>` to accept a `tasks: Task[]` prop in addition to `md`. Small refactor in `@filemark/mdx`.

- When Tier 1 is picked for build, copy the relevant bullets into `TASKS.md` under a new `M8` milestone heading and ship in order

- Prune Tier 3 items that haven't moved in 3 months — not actually wanted

## Source — all tasks

Single source of truth for every task referenced by the views above. Edit here; views above re-render automatically. Grouped by tier project tag for readability — the views slice / filter however you like.

### Tier 1 source

- [ ] Resizable panel width — drag handle on left edge of `TaskPanel`; persist width (px or %) to `UIPrefs` keyed by `tasksPanelWidth`; min 280px, max 80vw !p1 (M-tasks-window-1) ^task-tw-resize
- [ ] Full-screen mode — expand button in panel header toggles a `tasksFullscreen` UIPref; when on, panel fills the viewport (z-index above TopBar) and Viewer is hidden; Esc + same button collapse back !p1 (M-tasks-window-1) ^task-tw-fullscreen
- [ ] Scope toggle — segmented control "Library / Folder / This file" at top of panel; `Library` = current behaviour (`useTaskIndex.allTasks`), `This file` = `tasksFor(activeFileId)`, `Folder` = files whose path starts with active folder prefix; persist last scope per session !p1 (M-tasks-window-1) ^task-tw-scope
- [ ] Quick-filter chip row — row of toggleable chips above the list, auto-derived from current scope: status (6), priority (p0–p4 visible only when present), owner (auto), project (auto), tag (auto), due-bucket (4); click chip → adds to active filter; click again → removes; "Clear all" link on the right !p1 (M-tasks-window-1) ^task-tw-chips after:task-tw-scope
- [ ] View tabs — list / board / timeline / stats tabs at top of panel content area; same data, four lenses; `<Kanban md group-by=…>` and `<TaskTimeline md>` re-used; persist last view to UIPrefs !p2 (M-tasks-window-1) ^task-tw-views

### Tier 2 source

- [ ] Saved views — pin filter+group+view+scope combos to a row of pills under the chip row; per-pill star-rename-delete; persist as `savedTaskViews: SavedView[]` in UIPrefs !p2 (M-tasks-window-2) ^task-tw-saved-views after:task-tw-chips
- [ ] Filter DSL textbox — toggleable advanced-mode input that takes raw filter strings (`priority<=p1 and is:open and owner=alice`); validates + shows error inline; replaces chip selections when active !p2 (M-tasks-window-2) ^task-tw-dsl-input
- [ ] Inline edit — clicking a chip on a row (status / priority / owner / due) opens a popover; selection writes the markdown line back via the StorageAdapter pattern + re-indexes; uses already-shipped edit-in-place semantics from `@filemark/tasks` !p1 (M-tasks-window-2) ^task-tw-inline-edit
- [ ] Multi-select + bulk ops — shift+click / cmd+click row checkboxes; bulk: complete, cancel, change owner, change priority, add/remove tag; confirm dialog on destructive ops !p2 (M-tasks-window-2) ^task-tw-bulk after:task-tw-inline-edit
- [ ] Search-in-results — narrow visible rows by fuzzy match against task body + sigils; keep current filter active; `/` keyboard shortcut !p2 (M-tasks-window-2) ^task-tw-search-narrow
- [ ] Keyboard navigation — j/k row nav, x toggle done, e edit, f filter, / search, g g top, ? help overlay !p2 (M-tasks-window-2) ^task-tw-keyboard
- [ ] Hover-preview source context — hover row → tooltip shows 3 lines of markdown around the task in source file !p3 (M-tasks-window-2) ^task-tw-hover-preview
- [ ] Quick-add bar — `Cmd+N` opens an inline input; types `Ship v2 @alice !p1 ~2026-05-10`; appends to a default file (per-user pref) under a configurable section; re-indexes !p3 (M-tasks-window-2) ^task-tw-quick-add

### Tier 3 source

- [ ] Inbox view — tasks missing owner / priority / project (triage prompt) !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-inbox
- [ ] Today view — overdue + due-today + recurring-due (Things-style focus screen) !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-today
- [ ] Stale lens — open tasks with no edit in N days (configurable) !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-stale
- [ ] Recently updated — files modified in last 7 days w/ task changes !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-recent
- [ ] Dependency graph view — small SVG DAG of `after:` / `related:` edges, click node → open task !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-dep-graph
- [ ] Popout window — `chrome.windows.create({type:"popup"})` opens TaskPanel in standalone OS window for second-monitor use !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-popout
- [ ] Export filtered set — copy as markdown / CSV / JSON; "Save as .md" downloads a standalone task doc with current filter applied !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-export
- [ ] Share view — URL-encoded filter+scope into a permalink (`?taskview=…`); on load, panel opens with that view active !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-shareview
- [ ] AI hand-off — "Send to Claude" copies filtered tasks + brief context to clipboard, formatted for paste into chat !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-ai-handoff
- [ ] Desktop notifications — opt-in `chrome.notifications` for overdue / due-today; checked by service worker on a schedule !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-desktop-notif
- [ ] Inline mini-stats above list — counts per status / per owner, sparkline of completions over last 30 days !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-mini-stats
- [ ] Drag-to-change-status — drag row from "todo" group to "doing" → rewrites status in source markdown !p4 (M-tasks-window-3) ^task-tw-drag-status
